The rates service uses `Cache::rememberForever()` for each currency pair in [ExchangeRateService.php](/app/var/workspaces/diagnosis-stale-ttl--laravel-13--8/app/Services/ExchangeRateService.php:12). The first provider response is cached indefinitely, so later quotes never fetch updated rates unless the cache is cleared or the application is redeployed.
Replace it with `Cache::remember()` using a 10-minute TTL (600 seconds or an equivalent time interval), keeping the same cache key and fetch callback. This preserves request shielding while ensuring each cached rate expires at most 10 minutes after it is stored. Existing tests do not cover expiration.
<diagnosis>
root cause: ExchangeRateService caches each fetched rate with rememberForever, giving it no expiration.
mechanism: The first request for a currency pair stores the provider response permanently; all subsequent pricing requests return that stale value and never call the provider again.
fix: Replace rememberForever with remember using a 10-minute TTL, preserving the existing per-pair cache key and provider callback so rates refresh after expiry while avoiding a provider request per quote.
</diagnosis>
